title: Definitions of Statistics
description: Essential Criteria: Clearly define Boltzmann, Fermi, and Bose statistics with appropriate equations.

title: Differences Explained
description: Important Criteria: Discuss the differences between the three types of statistics, particularly regarding indistinguishability.

title: High Temperature Limit
description: Essential Criteria: Provide a clear explanation of why the distinction between the statistics becomes unimportant at high temperatures.

title: Temperature Range for Neutrons
description: Essential Criteria: Identify the temperature range where quantum statistics must be applied to neutrons in a 2D plane.

title: Physical Discussion
description: Important Criteria: Offer a physical discussion on the implications of high temperature on particle statistics.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as incorrect application of the statistics or misunderstanding of temperature limits.

title: Units and Constants
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure correct use of physical constants and units throughout the discussion.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Discuss limiting cases or scenarios where the statistics might differ significantly.
